result.topic_en: Calculations on prime-counting functions, inverting a relation of the form $\chi(x)=\sum f(x^{1/n})$ by alternating sums over roots, followed by integral transforms and series with $e^{-yx}$, $\log y$ and $\Psi(1)$-type constants; only fragments are legible.

methods.what: Relation between $\chi(x)$ and a sum of $f$ over roots of $x$ (prime-power counting via $\log\Pi(x)$)
Möbius-type inversion expressing $f$ via alternating sums of $\chi$ at roots of $x$
Double integral with exponential kernel factoring into a product of Laplace-type integrals
Theta-type series with logarithms expressed as an integral and an asymptotic expansion in powers of $1/x$

items.english: chi(x) is less than log Pi(x).
